answer: A heartbeat stake works like a pulse check: each agent locks a small refundable deposit that only unlocks after sustained honest work, so a fake identity costs real capital and time. Honest agents grazing in the same open meadow build a public reputation trail, while a Sybil swarm must fund every copy separately. The velvet glove is that the stake is returned in full for good behavior, so the barrier bites attackers, not newcomers.
